blocks.text: JBL Go 3 portable mini Bluetooth speaker features bold styling and rich JBL Pro Sound. With its new eye-catching edgy design, colorful fabrics and expressive details this a must-have speaker for your next outing. Your tunes will lift you up with big audio and punchy bass. It’s IP67 waterproof and dustproof so you can keep listening at the pool, park or in the shower. With its integrated loop, you can carry it anywhere. Go 3 comes in completely new shades and color combinations inspired by current street fashion. • JBL Go 3 portable mini Bluetooth speaker • Rich JBL Original Pro Sound • Ultra-portable design • 5 hours of playtime • Wireless Bluetooth Streaming • IPX67 Waterproof and dustproof

items.label: RICH JBL ORIGINAL PRO SOUND
items.value: The legendary JBL signature sound delivers surprisingly big audio and punchy bass from Go 3's small size.

items.label: ULTRA-PORTABLE DESIGN
items.value: JBL Go 3's ultra-portable design goes great with the latest styles, and its colorful fabrics and expressive details make it look as great as it sounds.

items.label: 5 HOURS OF PLAYTIME
items.value: Don't sweat the small stuff like charging your battery. Go 3 gives you up to 5 hours of battery life on a single charge.

items.label: WIRELESS BLUETOOTH STREAMING
items.value: Wirelessly stream music from your phone, tablet, or any other Bluetooth-enabled device.

items.label: IP67 WATERPROOF AND DUSTPROOF
items.value: To the pool. To the park. In the shower. JBL Go 3 is fully waterproof and dustproof, so you can bring your speaker anywhere.

items.label: Built-in Media
items.value: 1 x JBL Go 3, 1 x Type-C to Type-A charging cable, Quick Start Guide, Safety Sheet, Warranty Card
